I thought this game would be easier than ROR:2 given the fact that its 2d, but it's almost more challenging in ways because it limits your movement options and has slightly less jank. That said, still very fun :>

Bought this game because of its local co-op support and was left a bit underwhelmed. We start with two characters which didn't offer enough immediate variance between runs for three people. It felt like progression was quite slow since we only unlocked the enforcer and bandit after a couple of hours of playing.

There were some scale issues when playing on a TV since we needed enough room that we could occasionally spread out without the camera getting wonky which meant that everything was very small. In this game if you jump off a bridge, all of your friends follow you instead of the other way around.  The screen limitations completely negated at least one active item (Marble Gate), though to be honest that was kind of hilarious. It was easy to get punished by bad seeds since in local co-op the entire team needs to move as one and you can't split up to discover the gate so its possible a lot of time is wasted if you start searching the wrong direction. 

If you've already played this game single player or with online co-op and you have unlocked characters/artifacts then you're probably in for a good time. But don't expect to really unlock anything over the course of natural play when playing strictly local co-op.
